_about: Raw extraction for the comparison in benchmarks/results.md Section 4. Every value was read from the paper's full text (JATS XML from the Europe PMC REST API, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/<PMCID>/fullTextXML) during this task. Login + authentication phase only. 'paper_reported' is copied from the paper; 'counts' is what the comparison uses (our recount from the protocol steps; 'recount_matches_paper' says whether they agree). Security values: 'yes' = claimed/supported by the paper, 'no' = the paper's own text shows it is not provided, 'n/r' = not reported/analysed. Quotes are verbatim and short.

selection.criteria: Peer-reviewed, 2018+, two- or three-factor user authentication with a gateway/server in smart home / IoT / WSN, full text readable, paper contains its own computation and communication cost analysis. Two hash-based and two ECC-based schemes.

shortlisted_not_selected.reason: Readable and relevant (hash + symmetric, ProVerif), but the user model relies on location information rather than a password + smart card; Banerjee et al. and Oh et al. match our factor model more closely.
Readable; 6 messages with an online trusted authority in the login phase, a different architecture from ours.
Readable; WSN smart-home three-factor hash scheme, very similar profile to Banerjee et al. (kept one of the two).
Readable ECC three-factor WSN scheme, but much heavier (12Tecm + 48Th + 1TFE) and further from our setting than Zhao et al.
PUF-based; a PUF cannot be timed in software on this machine.
No peer-reviewed venue stated on arXiv or in the paper.
Full text could not be retrieved (MDPI returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; not indexed in Europe PMC).

GWN: k_j, s_j, h2*, ID_i = C1 xor h(K2||...), k_i, h1*, k_ij, h(SID||k_j||s_j), h3 [9h], K2 = kX [1 ecm] = 9h + 1ecm. Sj: h2, h(SID||k_j||s_j), h3*, SK, h4 [5h], Y = yP, yX [2 ecm] = 5h + 2ecm.
